title: Perry Local Schools
description: perrylocal.org Perry Local School District is a public PK to 12 school district in Perry Township, Stark County, Ohio, near Massillon, founded in 1853 and serving about 4100 students across seven schools. Led by Superintendent Nathan Stutz, it employs 312 certified teachers and 264 staff and boasts a 96.2 percent graduation rate and a 4.5 star Ohio School Report Card for 2025. Perry High School offers 13 AP courses and College Credit Plus with Kent State, Ashland and Walsh universities, and its Panthers compete in the Federal League. The district is building a new 62 million dollar Perry Middle School on the Hartwick Park site, uniting Pfeiffer and Edison schools for grades five to eight in a 156000 square foot LEED building designed by BSHM Architects. Funding is secured through the Ohio Facilities Construction Commission under CFAP.
